Catalog.Import.Title: Price list from a file
Catalog.Import.Intro: Add your whole price list in one go, or change many times and prices at once. Save the list from your spreadsheet as CSV and upload it here. You will see what will be added and what will change before anything does.
Catalog.Import.OwnFile.Title: Changing prices you already have?
Catalog.Import.OwnFile.Lead: Download your price list, change the numbers in a spreadsheet, save it as CSV and upload it here.
Catalog.Import.Columns.Title: What the file looks like
Catalog.Import.Columns.Lead: The first row names the columns, in any order. Only the name of the service is needed. A new service also needs its minutes and its price. Category and deposit are optional.
Catalog.Import.Rules.Changes: A service you already have (the same name) gets the time, the price and the deposit from the file. An empty cell leaves that value as it is.
Catalog.Import.Rules.Keeps: Nothing is removed. A service that is not in the file stays as it is, and so do its name, its category and the people who do it.
Catalog.Import.Rules.Booked: Visits already booked keep the price they were booked at. A person with their own price or time for a service keeps theirs.
